144MHz 上法拉第旋转量 ∝f⁻²，量值很小。: at 144 MHz the Faraday rotation scales as f⁻² and its magnitude is very small.
NOAA SWPC 每 3 小时发布；Kp ≥ 5 时高纬地区极光传播概率明显上: Issued by NOAA SWPC every 3 hours; when Kp ≥ 5 the probability of auroral propagation at high latitudes rises noticeably.
NOAA 极光预报给出可见范围与概率，可作为判断开通时间与纬度的粗略参考。: The NOAA aurora forecast gives the visible area and probability, useful as a rough guide to the opening time and latitude.
仅在强地磁暴时偶尔开通，属进阶尝试。: Opens only occasionally during strong geomagnetic storms — an advanced attempt.
以 6m（50 MHz）与 2m（144 MHz）为主，70cm 偶有开通，更高: Mainly 6 m (50 MHz) and 2 m (144 MHz); 70 cm opens occasionally and higher bands are seldom seen.
优先用 6m 配合 CW 或数字模式（MSK144 / FT8）尝试，极光信号起: Try 6 m first with CW or digital modes (MSK144 / FT8); auroral signals fluctuate fast, so short exchanges are more reliable.
信号含混时收窄带宽、放慢语音或改用 CW，可显著提高抄收率。: When signals are muddled, narrow the bandwidth, speak more slowly or switch to CW — this markedly improves copy rate.
全球地磁活动指数（0～9），Kp ≥ 5 即地磁暴。数值越大，极光区越靠南、传播: A global geomagnetic activity index (0–9); Kp ≥ 5 means a geomagnetic storm. The higher the value, the further south the auroral zone reaches and the stronger the propagation.
北美等地区可用，开通条件与 2m 相近。: Usable in North America and other areas, with opening conditions similar to 2 m.
南向（负值）且持续时能量更易注入极区，是极光活动的关键先兆。: When southward (negative) and sustained, energy is injected into the polar region more easily — a key precursor of auroral activity.
天线指向极光区，尽量使用圆极化或将水平天线转到最佳方位；极光会让极化面不断旋转。: Point the antenna at the auroral region; use circular polarisation if possible or rotate a horizontal antenna to the best bearing — the aurora keeps rotating the plane of polarisation.
天线需指向极光区（高纬的北 / 南方天空）。反射会使极化失真、去极化并快速起伏；: The antenna must point at the auroral region (towards the northern / southern sky at high latitudes). Reflection distorts the polarisation, depolarises it and makes it fluctuate rapidly;
太阳带电粒子沿地磁线注入极区高层大气，形成不规则电离体，可反射 VHF/UHF: Charged particles from the Sun are injected along geomagnetic field lines into the upper atmosphere over the polar regions, forming irregular ionised bodies that can reflect VHF/UHF waves.
实际以水平极化八木指向极区最常用，圆极化可减轻极化失配但并非公认「占优」——: in practice a horizontally polarised Yagi aimed at the polar region is used most often; circular polarisation can ease polarisation mismatch but is not generally accepted as "superior" —
持续高于约 500 km/s 时地磁扰动增强，是极光活动的上游驱动。: When sustained above about 500 km/s, geomagnetic disturbance intensifies — the upstream driver of auroral activity.
极光反射伴随强烈多径起伏，CW 听起来沙哑颤动、语音近似「低语」，是典型识别特征: Auroral reflection brings strong multipath fluctuation: CW sounds raspy and wavering and speech sounds almost like a whisper — a typical identifying signature.
极光活动集中在地磁纬度约 65°～70° 的环带；强地磁暴时环带向低纬扩展，中纬: Auroral activity is concentrated in a ring at about 65°–70° geomagnetic latitude; during strong geomagnetic storms the ring expands towards lower latitudes and mid-latitude paths may open.
极光通联最常用的波段，单次开通可达上千公里。: The band most used for auroral contacts; a single opening can reach more than a thousand kilometres.
次常用波段，信号较弱但同样可行。: The second most used band; signals are weaker but it works equally.
沙哑、颤动的音色属正常现象，不要误判为设备或馈线故障。: A raspy, wavering sound is normal — do not mistake it for an equipment or feedline fault.
盯住 Kp 与太阳风参数：地磁暴刚起、Kp 由 4 升到 5～7 时，往往是开通: Watch Kp and the solar wind parameters: just as a geomagnetic storm begins, when Kp rises from 4 to 5–7, is often the most intense opening window.
